## Behavior or native feature

Describe the expected result and current result. Include whether the problem affects reading, preserving, editing, rendering or exporting.

## Reproduction

App version, macOS/CPU, Python/Node version, HWP/HWPX version where known, and exact command or UI sequence. Record public-fixture source and hash where possible.

## Evidence

Original and output hashes; operation patch; warning/error codes; core/native/visual test outcomes. Use sanitized examples only. Do not post confidential documents, signatures, seals, credentials or private source text.

## Acceptance gate

State whether acceptance needs self-parser checks, an independent reader, Hancom reopen, a reference render, or all of them. A self-round-trip alone is not Hancom compatibility.
